name: Vervet Monkey
subject_description: A real wild vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus): grey-green-tinged fur, black face with a white brow band and pale cheek fur, small dexterous black hands and feet, long tail, cat-sized body about 40-60 cm excluding tail
anatomy_notes: Two arms with two small dexterous black hands, five fingers on each hand. Two legs with two black feet. One long tail with a darker tip. Black face with a white brow band and pale cheek fur; grey-green coat with lighter chest fur.

extra_panels.title: Gripping the clipboard
extra_panels.description: both hands gripping a standard pale beige clipboard (silver clip, one white sheet covering the board), the clipboard about as long as the monkey's torso
